errors.text: The proposed BCC matrix plus ordered B2/D0a precipitates is not the requested dual-phase solid-solution constitution and explicitly introduces intermetallic phases.
The severe-plastic-deformation and aging route does not reconstruct the supported high-energy ball-milling plus spark-plasma-sintering process window.
No cited evidence directly demonstrates that the proposed route produces both sub-50 nm grains and the claimed coherent dual-phase constitution while retaining greater than 10% ductility.

The falsification experiment does not isolate grain-boundary or precipitation strengthening from simple solid-solution strengthening using composition-, grain-size-, and defect-density-matched controls.
